title: Reverse a Linked List
summary: Reverse every pointer in a singly linked chain.
statement: Reverse the supplied singly linked list in place and return its new head. The input and output are displayed as arrays.
reference_solution:
def reverse_linked_list(head):
    previous = None
    current = head
    while current:
        following = current.next
        current.next = previous
        previous = current
        current = following
    return previous
brute_force_solution:
def reverse_linked_list(head):
    previous = None
    current = head
    while current:
        following = current.next
        current.next = previous
        previous = current
        current = following
    return previous
hints: Each node loses its original next pointer, so save it first.
Track previous, current, and following nodes.
Redirect current.next to previous, then advance both pointers.
The final previous pointer is the new head.
editorial: Walk through the chain once, saving the next node before reversing each pointer. No additional list is needed.

tests.explanation: Every next pointer is reversed, producing the values in the opposite order.
A one-node linked list is unchanged after reversal.
